home.overview.label: Home
home.overview.tooltip: Where you start: who is signed in, and the way to every page you can use.

auth.sign-in.label: Sign in
auth.sign-in.tooltip: Sign in with the provider your organisation uses.

installation.setup.label: Set up Fyniq
installation.setup.tooltip: The one-time setup of a new installation: the setup code, the first company and the recovery codes.

shell.command-palette.label: Search and commands
shell.command-palette.tooltip: Go to a page or run a command by typing its name. Shortcut: Ctrl+K, or ⌘K on a Mac.

appearance.theme.label: Theme
appearance.theme.tooltip: Light, Dark, or System to follow your device.

appearance.contrast.label: High contrast
appearance.contrast.tooltip: Stronger text and borders. System follows your device's contrast setting.

appearance.density.label: Density
appearance.density.tooltip: Comfortable rows are 40 px high; Compact rows are 32 px, to see more at once.

appearance.motion.label: Motion
appearance.motion.tooltip: Reduce motion shows every change at once, without animation.

auth.sign-out.label: Sign out
auth.sign-out.tooltip: Ends your session in this browser.

shell.mode.label: Experience mode
shell.mode.tooltip: Basic shows the essentials; Expert adds accounts, settings and every detail. It changes only what you see, never what you may do.

settings.overview.label: Settings
settings.overview.tooltip: Your own settings, and the organisation's that your roles let you see.

settings.profile.label: Profile and security
settings.profile.tooltip: Your experience mode, your passkeys and the devices you are signed in on.

session.step-up.label: Use a passkey
session.step-up.tooltip: Confirm it's you with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. It counts for 5 minutes.

session.sign-in-again.label: Sign in again
session.sign-in-again.tooltip: Sign in again with your provider and its authenticator app; you come back to this page.

passkey.add.label: Add a passkey
passkey.add.tooltip: Make a passkey on this device, so confirming it's you takes a touch. Needs a second factor in the last 5 minutes.

passkey.revoke.label: Revoke
passkey.revoke.tooltip: Stop this passkey working, for example on a lost device. It cannot be undone; add a new one instead.

device.sign-out.label: Sign out
device.sign-out.tooltip: End this session. It is signed out at its next request.

device.sign-out-others.label: Sign out everywhere else
device.sign-out-others.tooltip: End every session but this one.

inbox.overview.label: Inbox
inbox.overview.tooltip: What waits for you: requests to approve, your own requests, and the weekly review of high-risk actions.

approvals.request.label: Approval request
approvals.request.tooltip: One request: what it changes, who approves it in which step, and the signatures so far.

approvals.review-log.label: Review log
approvals.review-log.tooltip: Every high-risk action, for another founder to review once a week. Nobody reviews their own.

approval.approve.label: Approve
approval.approve.tooltip: Opens the confirmation: what you sign, then your passkey. The change is made with the last approval.

approval.reject.label: Reject
approval.reject.tooltip: Opens the confirmation: say why, then sign. Nothing changes.

approval.withdraw.label: Withdraw
approval.withdraw.tooltip: Cancel your own request, with any approvals it has. Nothing changes.

approval.copy-hash.label: Copy
approval.copy-hash.tooltip: Copy the envelope's fingerprint (SHA-256), to compare it with what another approver sees.

review.mark.label: Mark as reviewed
review.mark.tooltip: Record that you checked the actions you picked. Each is reviewed once.

settings.members.label: Members and roles
settings.members.tooltip: Everyone in the company with their roles, invitations not yet used, and role changes waiting for approval.

member.invite.label: Invite
member.invite.tooltip: Make a one-time code that gives a person the roles you choose. It works once, within 7 days.

member.change-roles.label: Change roles
member.change-roles.tooltip: Add or end this person's roles. Once the company has a second member, the change waits for another Owner.

member.add-role.label: Add role
member.add-role.tooltip: Give the role; it takes effect on their next page, or after approval.

member.end-role.label: End role
member.end-role.tooltip: End the role; the company always keeps an Owner.

settings.team-mode.label: Team mode
settings.team-mode.tooltip: How strictly duties are separated: Founder or Standard mode, and the roles that conflict now.

settings.approval-policies.label: Approval policies
settings.approval-policies.tooltip: Who approves each kind of change, in ordered steps.

team-mode.switch.label: Ask to switch
team-mode.switch.tooltip: Ask for the new mode; an Owner who did not ask approves it. Needs a reason for each conflict that stays.

approval-policy.change.label: Change policy
approval-policy.change.tooltip: Ask for new steps; an Owner or Controller who did not ask approves them. Waiting requests of this kind restart.

settings.organisation.label: Organisation
settings.organisation.tooltip: The profile documents print, and the settings that apply to the whole company.

settings.accounting.label: Accounting framework and policies
settings.accounting.tooltip: The framework your statements are prepared under and the policies Fyniq follows, each approved by the accountant.

accounting.record-framework.label: Record the framework
accounting.record-framework.tooltip: Record the framework and its edition from this financial year; the accountant then confirms it.

accounting.confirm-framework.label: Confirm
accounting.confirm-framework.tooltip: Confirm, as the accountant, that the company may use this framework; never one you recorded.

accounting.record-policy.label: Record the policy
accounting.record-policy.tooltip: Record the policy as the accountant decided it, from this financial year; the accountant then approves it.

accounting.approve-policy.label: Approve
accounting.approve-policy.tooltip: Approve this policy as the accountant; never one you wrote.

settings.statutory-packs.label: Statutory parameter packs
settings.statutory-packs.tooltip: GST rates and codes from official sources, with pinned tests; a version is used once activated.

setting.change.label: Change
setting.change.tooltip: Set a new value from a date, today or later. Preview checks it without saving.

setting.reset.label: Reset to recommended
setting.reset.tooltip: Record the recommended value as a new change, from the date chosen. Nothing is deleted.

pack.activate.label: Activate
pack.activate.tooltip: Ask to use this version; an Owner or Controller who did not ask approves it.

settings.templates.label: Templates
settings.templates.tooltip: How your invoices, quotes and other documents look, and the emails that carry them; published versions never change.

settings.template.label: Template
settings.template.tooltip: A template's style, theme, texts and versions, with a live preview of your details and sample data.

template.new.label: New template
template.new.tooltip: Start a draft from one of four styles; nothing changes on your documents until it is published.

template.save.label: Save draft
template.save.tooltip: Keep your changes as the draft; documents keep using the version in force.

template.publish.label: Publish
template.publish.tooltip: Make the saved draft the next version, which never changes; new documents render with it.

template.ask-approval.label: Ask for approval
template.ask-approval.tooltip: Another Owner or Controller, who did not save the draft, approves its publication.

template.rollback.label: Roll back
template.rollback.tooltip: Publish this earlier version again as the next version; your draft stays as it is.

template.default.label: Change default
template.default.tooltip: Choose which published template a document type uses; a customer's own template comes first.

template.bundle.label: Template bundle
template.bundle.tooltip: Export templates as one JSON file, or import one as drafts that publish like any other.

review.awaiting-verification.label: Needs additional verification
review.awaiting-verification.tooltip: Some rules this page uses await a specialist's review. Check the figures before you rely on them or file them.

nav.accounting.label: Accounting
nav.accounting.tooltip: Journals, the periods they post in, and the chart of accounts.

accounting.chart.label: Chart of accounts
accounting.chart.tooltip: Every account the books post to, by type, with its report group, function, GST code and flags.

chart.add.label: New account
chart.add.tooltip: Add an account; its code and type never change once added.

chart.load-standard.label: Load the standard chart
chart.load-standard.tooltip: The Singapore start-up chart of 87 accounts, for a chart with no accounts yet.

contacts.overview.label: Contacts
contacts.overview.tooltip: The customers and vendors the company deals with.

items.overview.label: Items and prices
items.overview.tooltip: The products and services the company sells, with a unit price per currency.

contact.add.label: New contact
contact.add.tooltip: Add a customer, a vendor or both; Fyniq checks for a possible duplicate first.

contact.templates.label: Templates
contact.templates.tooltip: Choose the published templates this contact's documents and emails use, before the default.

contact.bank-details.label: Bank details
contact.bank-details.tooltip: Where payments to this vendor go: one account per currency, changed only with a second person's approval.

bank-details.change.label: Change bank details
bank-details.change.tooltip: Prepare a new account for one currency with the vendor's letter. It takes effect only when another person approves it.

bank-details.ask.label: Ask for approval
bank-details.ask.tooltip: Payments to the vendor freeze until another person approves or rejects it, or you withdraw it. Every founder is told at once.

bank-details.reveal.label: Show number
bank-details.reveal.tooltip: Show the full account number once you confirm it's you. The audit trail records each look.

bank-change.attach-evidence.label: Attach
bank-change.attach-evidence.tooltip: Attach the vendor's letter, or a screenshot of their confirmation through a channel you already knew. It is kept as bank details.

purchases.payment-batches.label: Payment batches
purchases.payment-batches.tooltip: Pay approved bills and claims together from one bank account: prepared, approved by another person, then released.

purchases.payment-batch.label: Payment batch
purchases.payment-batch.tooltip: One batch: its payments by payee, what holds any, its approval, its release and whether each is paid.

batch.new.label: New batch
batch.new.tooltip: Start a batch for a payment date with the bills planned by then and the claims owed. Keep or remove each one next.

batch.ask.label: Ask for approval
batch.ask.tooltip: Another person approves it before it is released. Its total and each payee's account are what they approve.

batch.reapprove.label: Ask to approve again
batch.reapprove.tooltip: A payee's account or an amount changed since it was approved. The approver sees what it pays now.

batch.release.label: Release
batch.release.tooltip: Posts each payment and writes the payment list, once you confirm it's you. Then pay it in the bank.

batch.download.label: Download payment list
batch.download.tooltip: The list to key into your bank, with full account numbers, once you confirm it's you. Each download is recorded.

batch.remittance-again.label: Send again
batch.remittance-again.tooltip: A supplier's remittance advice that gave up after several tries is sent once more, with a reason. It is still sent at most once.

batch.cancel.label: Cancel batch
batch.cancel.tooltip: An approved batch not yet released is cancelled with a reason; its bills and claims are free again.

profile.bank-account.label: Bank account for reimbursements
profile.bank-account.tooltip: Where your expense claims are paid. Only you enter it; someone in finance approves each change.

my-bank.change.label: Change my bank account
my-bank.change.tooltip: Enter your Singapore bank account with a screenshot of your banking app. It takes effect when someone in finance approves it.

my-bank.ask.label: Ask for approval
my-bank.ask.tooltip: Payments to you wait until someone in finance approves it, or you withdraw it.

my-bank.withdraw.label: Withdraw
my-bank.withdraw.tooltip: Take the change back: your account stays as it was, and payments to you are no longer held.

my-bank-change.attach-evidence.label: Attach
my-bank-change.attach-evidence.tooltip: Attach a screenshot of your banking app, or your statement's header, showing your name and the number. It is kept as bank details.

claimant-bank-change.attach-evidence.label: Attach
claimant-bank-change.attach-evidence.tooltip: Only the person attaches their own evidence; compare it with the number before you approve.

item.add.label: New item
item.add.tooltip: Add a product or service with its prices; its code never changes.

accounting.journals.label: Journals
accounting.journals.tooltip: Manual journals: prepare, check, post, and reverse a posted one with a reason.

accounting.journal.label: Journal
accounting.journal.tooltip: One journal: its lines as entered, who prepared and posted it, and what posting writes.

nav.purchases.label: Purchases
nav.purchases.tooltip: What the company buys: suppliers' bills, what is owed to them, and paying them.

banking.accounts.label: Banking
banking.accounts.tooltip: Every money account, its balance, how up to date its data is, and the lines still to categorise.

bank-account.new.label: Add account
bank-account.new.tooltip: Add a bank, card, wallet, gateway or cash account, and choose where its data comes from.

bank-account.source.label: Where its data comes from
bank-account.source.tooltip: Statement files you import, the bank's reports by email, or a read-only connector such as Wise or Airwallex.

banking.cash-position.label: Cash position
banking.cash-position.tooltip: The cash in every open money account, other currencies at the day's rate; an account with no rate is left out and listed.

bank-account.complete-to.label: Complete to
bank-account.complete-to.tooltip: The last day the account's statements cover with no break in the balance chain before it.

banking.account.label: Money account
banking.account.tooltip: One account's statements and their continuity, its lines and their status, gaps, possible duplicates and pending alerts.

banking.import.label: Import statements
banking.import.tooltip: Bring in statement files for one account or several, see what each adds before anything is saved, then import.

bank-signal.dismiss.label: Dismiss the alert
bank-signal.dismiss.tooltip: The alert stops showing its invoice as likely paid. Nothing is posted, and the reason is kept in the audit trail.

banking.categorise.label: Categorise
banking.categorise.tooltip: The lines waiting for a person: accept a suggestion, change it, or skip; nothing is applied by itself.

banking.categorise-grid.label: Grid view
banking.categorise-grid.tooltip: Every waiting line with its best suggestion, to accept several at once or split, transfer and match them.

banking.reconcile-now.label: Reconcile now
banking.reconcile-now.tooltip: Fyniq reconciles the exact matches among the waiting lines by itself, within the organisation's limits; the rest stays for you.

bank-line.accept.label: Accept
bank-line.accept.tooltip: Post the line as the chosen suggestion says: a payment of the document, or the rule's category.

bank-line.change.label: Change the category
bank-line.change.tooltip: Choose the account the whole line posts to, its GST code and, if you like, its contact.

bank-line.split.label: Split the line
bank-line.split.tooltip: Post the line to several accounts, each part with its amount; one part may take the rest.

bank-line.transfer.label: Mark as a transfer
bank-line.transfer.tooltip: Money moved between two of your accounts: match it to the other side's line, or leave it in transit until that line arrives.

bank-line.match.label: Match to documents
bank-line.match.tooltip: Settle a customer's invoices or a supplier's bills with the line, several at once if it paid several.

bank-line.suspense.label: Suspense
bank-line.suspense.tooltip: Post the line to suspense (2999) until its purpose is known; categorising or matching it later reverses that.

banking.rules.label: Bank rules
banking.rules.tooltip: Rules suggest how to code the lines they meet, the first in the order winning; test each against the lines held before saving it.

banking.auto-reconciled.label: Auto-reconciled
banking.auto-reconciled.tooltip: What Fyniq reconciled by itself, why and when; undo any of it while its month is open.

bank-rule.auto-apply.label: Ask to apply by itself
bank-rule.auto-apply.tooltip: Ask another person to let the rule reconcile the lines it meets without a click, within the organisation's limits.

banking.reconciliation.label: Reconciliation
banking.reconciliation.tooltip: Prove the books agree with the bank for a month: the statement's balance, the books' balance and the lines between them.

bank-reconciliation.sign.label: Sign it off
bank-reconciliation.sign.tooltip: Sign off a reconciliation another person prepared, after confirming it's you; it is then locked with the month.

purchases.bills.label: Bills
purchases.bills.tooltip: Every bill from a supplier: its total, when it falls due, and whether it is posted, waiting for approval or voided.

purchases.bill.label: Bill
purchases.bill.tooltip: One bill: its lines as the supplier's invoice states them, its states, and what posting it writes.

bill.new.label: New bill
bill.new.tooltip: Enter a supplier's invoice: who sent it, its number and date, and its lines with their GST.

bill.save.label: Save as a draft
bill.save.tooltip: Keep it as a draft (✎); nothing posts until it is posted.

bill.post.label: Post
bill.post.tooltip: Post it to the ledger on its date: it adds its total to what the company owes the supplier.

bill.ask-approval.label: Ask for approval
bill.ask-approval.tooltip: Its total is above the self-approval threshold: another person, who did not prepare it, approves it and it posts then.

bill.void.label: Void
bill.void.tooltip: Post a reversing entry on a date you choose, with a reason; the bill stays in the books, marked voided.

bill.ask-void.label: Ask to void
bill.ask-void.tooltip: In Founder mode another founder approves a void first; it posts on the date you choose once they approve.

bill.edit.label: Edit
bill.edit.tooltip: Correct a posted bill: the entry it has is reversed and the new version posts, in one step, with a reason.

bill.post-edit.label: Post the edit
bill.post-edit.tooltip: Reverse the entry the bill has, on its date, and post the new version: its month must be open.

bill.ask-edit.label: Ask to post the edit
bill.ask-edit.tooltip: In Founder mode another founder approves an edit first; it posts when they approve it.

credit.new.label: New credit note
credit.new.tooltip: Enter a supplier's credit note: what they credit the company, line by line, with its GST. Posting it takes it off what is owed.

credit.apply.label: Apply to a bill
credit.apply.tooltip: Use the credit to settle one of the supplier's open bills in its currency: both go down by the amount.

credit.refund.label: Record refund
credit.refund.tooltip: Record money the supplier paid back against the credit: the date, the account it came into and how much. It posts at once.

purchases.orders.label: Purchase orders
purchases.orders.tooltip: What you buy from suppliers, how many and at what price, agreed before the bill arrives; bills are made from them.

purchases.order.label: Purchase order
purchases.order.tooltip: One order: its lines, its approval, what bills take of each line, and the bills made from it.

order.new.label: New order
order.new.tooltip: Raise a purchase order: the supplier, and what you buy, how many and at what price.

order.save.label: Save as a draft
order.save.tooltip: Save the order. Nothing is committed until it is approved; it never posts to the books.

order.approve.label: Approve
order.approve.tooltip: Approve the order: at or below the self-approval threshold you approve it alone; above it, ask another person.

order.ask-approval.label: Ask for approval
order.ask-approval.tooltip: Ask another person who approves bills, and did not prepare this order, to approve it.

order.bill.label: Make a bill
order.bill.tooltip: Make a draft bill of what the supplier invoices: how much of each line. Enter their invoice on it and post it.

order.close.label: Close order
order.close.tooltip: Close the order with a reason: no more bills are made from it; those made already stand.

purchases.recurring-bills.label: Recurring
purchases.recurring-bills.tooltip: Bills that repeat, such as the office rent: Fyniq makes each one's draft on its date, and a person posts it.

purchases.recurring-bill.label: Recurring bill
purchases.recurring-bill.tooltip: One recurring bill: its schedule, its supplier and lines, its next draft and what would stop its drafts posting.

recurring-bill.new.label: New recurring bill
recurring-bill.new.tooltip: Set up a bill that repeats every 1, 3, 6 or 12 months; each draft waits for a person to add the supplier's number and post it.

recurring-bill.save.label: Save
recurring-bill.save.tooltip: Save it. A change to its supplier or lines is a new version; drafts already made keep theirs.

recurring-bill.check.label: Check
recurring-bill.check.tooltip: See the date of its next draft and what would stop its drafts posting, without saving.

recurring-bill.pause.label: Pause
recurring-bill.pause.tooltip: Stop making drafts until you resume it. The drafts already made stay.

recurring-bill.resume.label: Resume
recurring-bill.resume.tooltip: Start making drafts again from today; the dates passed while it was paused are skipped.

bill.calendar.label: Payment dates
bill.calendar.tooltip: Each unpaid bill on its planned payment date, else on its due date. Plan a bill's payment from its page.

bill.plan-payment.label: Plan payment
bill.plan-payment.tooltip: Choose the day to pay it. A plan posts nothing; record the payment when it is made.

inbox.bills-to-pay.label: Bills to pay
inbox.bills-to-pay.tooltip: Bills overdue, or due or planned to be paid within the organisation's reminder days.

bill.nature.label: Nature of payment
bill.nature.tooltip: What the payment is for. The tax agent decides once per supplier and nature whether tax is withheld from it.

bill.withholding.label: Withholding tax
bill.withholding.tooltip: Tax may be withheld from payments to it and paid to IRAS, as the tax agent decides.

bill.record-decision.label: Record decision
bill.record-decision.tooltip: Record what the tax agent decided for this supplier and nature of payment: nothing withheld, or the rate to withhold.

bill.input-tax.label: Input tax
bill.input-tax.tooltip: What the GST claim rests on: the document, the supplier's registration and whom it is addressed to.

bill.business-share.label: Business share (%)
bill.business-share.tooltip: How much of the purchase is used for the business; only that share of the GST is claimed. Leave blank for all of it.

bill.tax-agent.label: The tax agent's decision
bill.tax-agent.tooltip: Some claims the rules leave to the tax agent. Record what they decided, and attach their advice; until then the GST is not claimed.

bill.spread.label: Spread over months
bill.spread.tooltip: For a cost paid ahead, such as a year's subscription: it goes to Prepayments, and one part a month moves to the cost. Leave blank to cost it on the invoice date.

bill.releases.label: Spread over months
bill.releases.tooltip: Each month's part of a spread cost, moved from Prepayments to the cost on its date. Months to come are projections, not in the books yet.

bill.attach-evidence.label: Attach
bill.attach-evidence.tooltip: Attach the supplier's invoice or another file the bill rests on. Fyniq scans it; once the bill is posted the file is kept and never deleted.

bill.record-payment.label: Record payment
bill.record-payment.tooltip: Record money already paid to the supplier for this bill: the date, the account it left and how much. It posts at once.

bill-payment.void.label: Void
bill-payment.void.tooltip: Post a reversing entry on a date you choose, with a reason; the bill is open again by what the payment paid.

bill-payment.ask-void.label: Ask to void
bill-payment.ask-void.tooltip: In Founder mode another founder approves a payment's void first; the bill reopens once they approve.

journal.new.label: New journal
journal.new.tooltip: Prepare a journal: its date, what it is for and its lines, whose debits equal their credits.

journal.save.label: Save as a draft
journal.save.tooltip: Keep it as a draft (✎); nothing posts until it is posted.

journal.check.label: Check
journal.check.tooltip: Run the posting rules without saving anything, and see what posting writes in the base currency.

journal.post.label: Post
journal.post.tooltip: Post it to the ledger on its date. A posted journal is never edited: it is reversed.

journal.reverse.label: Reverse
journal.reverse.tooltip: Post a reversing entry with every line the other way round, on a date you choose, with a reason.

journal.ask-approval.label: Ask for approval
journal.ask-approval.tooltip: Its debits are above the self-approval threshold: another person, who did not prepare it, approves it and it posts then.

journal.reverse-on.label: Reverses by itself
journal.reverse-on.tooltip: For an accrual: Fyniq posts the reversal on the date you choose, usually the first of the next month, once the journal is posted.

journal.edit.label: Edit
journal.edit.tooltip: Correct a posted journal: the entry it has is reversed on its date and the new version posts, in one step, with a reason.

journal.post-edit.label: Post the edit
journal.post-edit.tooltip: Reverse the entry the journal has, on its date, and post the new version: both months must be open.

journal.ask-edit.label: Ask to post the edit
journal.ask-edit.tooltip: In Founder mode another founder approves an edit first; it posts when they approve it.

accounting.recurring.label: Recurring
accounting.recurring.tooltip: Journals that repeat, such as a monthly accrual: Fyniq makes each one's draft on its date, and a person posts it.

accounting.recurring-journal.label: Recurring journal
accounting.recurring-journal.tooltip: One recurring journal: its schedule, its lines, its next draft and what would stop its drafts posting.

recurring.new.label: New recurring journal
recurring.new.tooltip: Set up a journal that repeats every 1, 3, 6 or 12 months; each draft waits for a person to post it.

recurring.save.label: Save
recurring.save.tooltip: Save it. A change to its lines is a new version; drafts already made keep theirs.

recurring.check.label: Check
recurring.check.tooltip: See the date of its next draft and what would stop its drafts posting, without saving.

recurring.reverses.label: Each draft reverses by itself
recurring.reverses.tooltip: For an accrual: each draft reverses on the first day of the next month once it is posted.

recurring.pause.label: Pause
recurring.pause.tooltip: Stop making drafts until you resume it. The drafts already made stay.

recurring.resume.label: Resume
recurring.resume.tooltip: Start making drafts again from today; the dates passed while it was paused are skipped.

journal.waiting.label: Automatic reversal waiting
journal.waiting.tooltip: Its reversal is dated in a month that is closed or a year not opened yet; it posts within the hour once that month is open.

journal.ask-reverse.label: Ask to reverse
journal.ask-reverse.tooltip: In Founder mode another founder approves a reversal first; it posts on the date you choose once they approve.

accounting.periods.label: Periods and close
accounting.periods.tooltip: The monthly periods of each financial year, open or closed; opening the next year and closing a month.

period.open-year.label: Open the year
period.open-year.tooltip: Create the monthly periods of the next financial year, so its journals and documents can post.

accounting.opening-balances.label: Opening balances
accounting.opening-balances.tooltip: Each account's balance on the day the books start, as a debit or a credit, adding up to zero.

journal.attach-evidence.label: Attach
journal.attach-evidence.tooltip: Attach a file that supports the journal. Once the journal is posted, its files are kept and never deleted.

opening.save.label: Save as a draft
opening.save.tooltip: Keep the balances as a draft (✎); nothing posts until they are posted.

opening.check.label: Check
opening.check.tooltip: Run the posting rules without saving anything: the balances must net to zero, in the base currency.

opening.post.label: Post
opening.post.tooltip: Post the balances at the books start, once. Changing them afterwards needs another person's approval.

opening.ask-change.label: Ask for approval
opening.ask-change.tooltip: Ask another person to approve the corrected balances. Nothing changes until they approve.

accounting.period-close.label: Close a month
accounting.period-close.tooltip: Run the close checks, then another founder attests and closes the month, which then refuses every posting.

close.run-checks.label: Run the checks
close.run-checks.tooltip: Check the month can close, recording the ledger as the checks find it. Another founder attests them.

close.attest.label: Attest and close
close.attest.tooltip: Confirm the month's figures and close it: nothing posts in it afterwards. You cannot attest checks you ran.

close.reopen.label: Ask to reopen
close.reopen.tooltip: Ask for the month to take postings again, with a reason; another founder approves it.

close.mark-task.label: Done
close.mark-task.tooltip: Mark the task done for this month. Run the checks again afterwards so they see it.

close.skip-task.label: Skip
close.skip-task.tooltip: Skip the task for this month only, with a reason. The founder who attests the close reads it.

close.edit-template.label: Save the template
close.edit-template.tooltip: Save the tasks every month's checklist has, as a new version. Months already worked on keep their marks.

accounting.currencies.label: Currencies
accounting.currencies.tooltip: Exchange rates into the base currency: the daily feed, your own rates, and the rate a posting in another currency takes.

accounting.fixed-assets.label: Fixed assets
accounting.fixed-assets.tooltip: The assets the company owns and uses for more than a year: their cost, monthly depreciation and net book value, and their sales and write-offs.

reports.index.label: Reports
reports.index.tooltip: The financial statements and the other reports, each with what it answers. Every figure opens to the lines behind it.

reports.statement.label: Financial statements
reports.statement.tooltip: The profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow and trial balance for any run of months, with a comparison, read at one ledger revision.

reports.accountant-exports.label: Accountant exports
reports.accountant-exports.tooltip: The general ledger, the trial balance, the journal entries, the fixed asset schedule, and the receivables and payables in detail, as Excel or CSV for the accountant or the auditor.

statement.export.label: Export
statement.export.tooltip: Download the statement as shown, at its ledger revision: an Excel workbook with a data tab, a PDF to print, or CSV. Each export is recorded in the audit trail.

statement.revenue.label: Revenue
statement.revenue.tooltip: What customers paid for in the period, before any costs.

statement.cost_of_sales.label: Cost of sales
statement.cost_of_sales.tooltip: Costs that grow with each customer served, such as hosting, delivery contractors and card fees.

statement.gross_profit.label: Gross profit
statement.gross_profit.tooltip: What is left from revenue after the costs of serving customers.

statement.operating_expenses.label: Operating expenses
statement.operating_expenses.tooltip: The cost of running the company: the team, the office, tools, marketing and advisers.

statement.ebitda.label: EBITDA
statement.ebitda.tooltip: The result before depreciation, interest and tax: how the business itself is doing.

statement.net_profit.label: Net profit
statement.net_profit.tooltip: The result after every cost and tax: a minus is a loss.

statement.current_assets.label: Current assets
statement.current_assets.tooltip: Cash, and what customers and others owe the company, which turns into cash within a year.

statement.non_current_assets.label: Non-current assets
statement.non_current_assets.tooltip: Equipment and software the company keeps for more than a year, less what has been used up.

statement.current_liabilities.label: Current liabilities
statement.current_liabilities.tooltip: What the company owes and pays within a year: suppliers, staff, tax and income received ahead.

statement.borrowings.label: Borrowings
statement.borrowings.tooltip: Loans to the company, from a director, a bank or investors.

statement.equity.label: Equity
statement.equity.tooltip: What is left for the shareholders: the capital they put in and the results so far.

statement.net_operating.label: Net cash from operating activities
statement.net_operating.tooltip: Cash the business itself brought in or used: the profit, less what customers still owe, plus what is still to pay.

statement.net_investing.label: Net cash from investing activities
statement.net_investing.tooltip: Cash spent on or received for equipment and other long-term assets.

statement.net_financing.label: Net cash from financing activities
statement.net_financing.tooltip: Cash from or to shareholders and lenders: shares issued, loans taken and repaid.

accounting.schedules.label: Schedules
accounting.schedules.tooltip: Costs paid ahead and income received ahead, spread over the months they belong to: what each has recognised, what remains, and Prepayments and Deferred revenue tied to them.

fixed-assets.register.label: Register
fixed-assets.register.tooltip: Add the purchase to the register as an asset: its cost is what the line put on the asset account; enter its useful life.

fixed-assets.register-opening.label: Register one bought earlier
fixed-assets.register-opening.tooltip: Add an asset bought before the books start, with the cost and accumulated depreciation the opening balances carry for it.

fixed-assets.unregistered.label: Not in the register yet
fixed-assets.unregistered.tooltip: Purchases on asset accounts that no asset was registered from; one at or above the capitalisation threshold should be registered.

fixed-assets.change.label: Change
fixed-assets.change.tooltip: Rename it, or change its useful life or residual value for the months not posted yet.

fixed-assets.dispose.label: Sell or write off
fixed-assets.dispose.tooltip: Record its sale or write-off, whole or in part, with the gain or loss to 7050.

fixed-assets.void.label: Void
fixed-assets.void.tooltip: Reverse a disposal recorded by mistake and restore the asset; in Founder mode another person approves it.

fixed-assets.void-asset.label: Void the asset
fixed-assets.void-asset.tooltip: Undo an asset registered by mistake: its depreciation is reversed and its line can be registered again; in Founder mode another person approves it.

fixed-assets.voided.label: Voided
fixed-assets.voided.tooltip: Assets voided as registered by mistake: their depreciation reversed, their lines free to register again.

fx.find-rate.label: Find the rate a posting takes
fx.find-rate.tooltip: A posting without a rate of its own takes your rate for its date, else the daily feed's from that day or up to 7 days before, else your monthly rate.

fx.add-rate.label: Add a rate
fx.add-rate.tooltip: Enter a rate for a day, which overrides the daily feed and replaces your earlier rate for that day, or for a month of the monthly table.

fx.import-rates.label: Import a file
fx.import-rates.tooltip: Enter the rates of a CSV file at once, each on its own: a row that cannot be entered is listed with why, and the others are kept.

fx.withdraw-rate.label: Withdraw
fx.withdraw-rate.tooltip: Postings no longer take the rate; postings that took it keep it. The rate stays listed with who withdrew it and why.

fx.revalue.label: Revalue
fx.revalue.tooltip: Restate the month's foreign-currency balances at its last day's rate. The gain or loss posts on the month's last day and reverses on the next month's first.

close.year-end.label: Year end
close.year-end.tooltip: Nothing is posted at year end: Fyniq moves the year's result into retained earnings whenever it reads the next year's balances.

close.explain-variance.label: Explain
close.explain-variance.tooltip: Say why the account moved against the previous month. It explains these totals: if either changes, the close asks again.

reports.general-ledger.label: General ledger
reports.general-ledger.tooltip: Every posted line of the accounts you choose over two dates, with a running balance and each line's source.

ledger.export.label: Export CSV
ledger.export.tooltip: Download the lines as CSV: plain decimals with an ASCII minus, ready for a spreadsheet.

settings.notifications.label: Notifications
settings.notifications.tooltip: How each kind of notification reaches you by email, your quiet hours, and a test notification; in the app they always show.

settings.announcements.label: Announcements
settings.announcements.tooltip: Banners under the header on every page, for everyone or chosen roles, from a start to an end.

notification.centre.label: Notifications
notification.centre.tooltip: What happened that concerns you: approvals, security notices, email-in and operations. Unread ones are counted on the bell.

notification.read.label: Mark read
notification.read.tooltip: Mark this notification read; it stays in All until you archive it.

notification.unread.label: Mark unread
notification.unread.tooltip: Mark this notification unread again, so the bell counts it.

notification.archive.label: Archive
notification.archive.tooltip: Move this notification to Archived for good; it stays there for the record.

notification.read-all.label: Mark all read
notification.read-all.tooltip: Mark every unread notification read at once.

notification.preference.label: Reset to recommended
notification.preference.tooltip: Go back to how Fyniq recommends this kind reaches you by email.

notification.quiet-hours.label: Quiet hours
notification.quiet-hours.tooltip: Hours, in Singapore time, when email that would go at once waits; security notices still go at once.

notification.test.label: Send me a test notification
notification.test.tooltip: Send yourself a test through every channel you receive notifications on: the app, and email when you have a verified sign-in email.

banner.dismiss.label: Dismiss
banner.dismiss.tooltip: Hide this banner for you on every device; a critical banner stays until it ends.

announcement.publish.label: Publish
announcement.publish.tooltip: Publish the banner: it shows from its start to its end, and never changes once published.

announcement.withdraw.label: End now
announcement.withdraw.tooltip: End this announcement now, or cancel it before it starts; to say more, publish another.

settings.integrations.label: Integrations
settings.integrations.tooltip: The connectors that link Fyniq to other services, such as the email providers: their status and health, and the catalogue this release ships.

settings.integration.label: Connector
settings.integration.tooltip: One connector: its lifecycle, configuration and secrets, its test and health, an upgrade to consent to, and its history.

connector.install.label: Install
connector.install.tooltip: Install the connector and consent to its manifest; it stays off until it is configured, tested and enabled. A second person approves it first.

connector.health.label: Health
connector.health.tooltip: OK when the connector is enabled and its last test passed; Failing when that test failed; Not tested otherwise.

connector.data-classes.label: Sends out
connector.data-classes.tooltip: The kinds of data the connector's manifest says it sends out of Fyniq, such as personal data or business figures, and nothing else.

connector.configure.label: Save changes
connector.configure.tooltip: Ask to save the configuration; a second person approves it, and the connector is tested again before it is enabled.

connector.secret.label: Set
connector.secret.tooltip: Store the value in Secret Manager at once; it is never shown again, and it is used once a second person approves.

connector.test.label: Test connection
connector.test.tooltip: Run the connector's test action now and record whether it passed, with the reason; never what the provider sent back.

connector.enable.label: Enable
connector.enable.tooltip: Ask to turn the connector on: it needs a passed test and every secret set, and a second person approves it.

connector.pause.label: Pause
connector.pause.tooltip: Stop new work at once and hold its queue; the others are told. Takes effect without waiting for a second person.

connector.resume.label: Resume
connector.resume.tooltip: Ask to pick up where it stopped; a second person approves it.

connector.disable.label: Disable
connector.disable.tooltip: Ask to turn the connector off; what happens to its queued work is in its manifest. A second person approves it.

connector.uninstall.label: Uninstall
connector.uninstall.tooltip: Ask to remove the connector for good and delete its secrets; its audit history stays. A second person approves it.

connector.consent.label: Consent to the upgrade
connector.consent.tooltip: Consent to the release's manifest; new data classes, destinations or scopes need a second person's approval too.

connector.order.label: Move
connector.order.tooltip: Ask to change its place among the email providers: 1 sends, the next only what the ones before it refused.

connector.approve.label: Approve
connector.approve.tooltip: Approve the other Super admin's change to an installation connector, over the request you read; it takes effect at once.

connector.reject.label: Reject
connector.reject.tooltip: Reject the change with a reason; a secret set for it is destroyed.

email.sender.label: Change
email.sender.tooltip: Choose the address on a sending domain that this purpose's email comes from, or go back to the platform's sender.

email.release.label: Release
email.release.tooltip: Send to this address again; fix the contact's email first, or the next message bounces too.

nav.sales.label: Sales
nav.sales.tooltip: What the company sells: invoices to customers, what they owe, and getting paid.

sales.invoices.label: Invoices
sales.invoices.tooltip: Every invoice and credit note to a customer: its total, when it falls due, whether it is issued, sent, paid or overdue.

sales.invoice.label: Invoice
sales.invoice.tooltip: One invoice: its lines, its totals and GST, its states, its emails, and what issuing it writes.

invoice.new.label: New invoice
invoice.new.tooltip: Bill a customer: who it is for, its date, and its lines as quantity × price before GST.

credit-note.new.label: New credit note
credit-note.new.tooltip: Give a customer credit: for an invoice they were charged too much on, or standalone.

invoice.save.label: Save as a draft
invoice.save.tooltip: Keep it as a draft (✎); nothing posts and nothing is sent until it is issued.

invoice.issue.label: Issue
invoice.issue.tooltip: Number it and post it to the ledger on its date: it adds its total to what the customer owes.

invoice.ask-approval.label: Ask for approval
invoice.ask-approval.tooltip: Its total is above the self-approval threshold: another person approves it, and it is issued as they do.

invoice.email.label: Email
invoice.email.tooltip: Send it to the customer with its PDF and a secure link they open without signing in.

invoice.void.label: Void
invoice.void.tooltip: Post a reversing entry with a reason; the invoice stays in the books, marked voided.

invoice.ask-void.label: Ask to void
invoice.ask-void.tooltip: In Founder mode another founder approves a void first.

invoice.edit.label: Edit
invoice.edit.tooltip: Change an issued invoice: its entry is reversed and the new one posted, with a reason.

invoice.post-edit.label: Post the edit
invoice.post-edit.tooltip: Reverse the old entry and post the new one, in one go, with the reason.

invoice.ask-edit.label: Ask to edit
invoice.ask-edit.tooltip: In Founder mode another founder approves the edit first.

invoice.attach-evidence.label: Attach a file
invoice.attach-evidence.tooltip: Keep what the invoice rests on with it, such as the customer's purchase order.

invoice.spread.label: Spread over months
invoice.spread.tooltip: Earn the line's revenue month by month: issuing puts it on Deferred revenue, and one part a month is released.

invoice.discount.label: Discount
invoice.discount.tooltip: A percentage off the line's quantity × price, before GST.

credit-note.credits.label: Invoice it credits
credit-note.credits.tooltip: Link it to the customer's issued invoice it corrects: GST is adjusted at that invoice's rates, and it credits at most its total.

sales.quotes.label: Quotes and orders
sales.quotes.tooltip: Every quote to a customer and every sales order: its total, validity date, status, and whether it was emailed and answered.

sales.quote.label: Quote
sales.quote.tooltip: One quote or sales order: its lines, totals and GST, its status, the customer's answer, and what has been invoiced of it.

quote.new.label: New quote
quote.new.tooltip: Offer a customer lines at a price until a date.

sales-order.new.label: New sales order
sales-order.new.tooltip: Record an order a customer placed, to invoice later.

quote.save.label: Save as a draft
quote.save.tooltip: Keep it as a draft (✎); nothing is sent until it is sent.

quote.send.label: Send
quote.send.tooltip: Number it from its sequence and mark it sent: it counts in the pipeline until it is answered or expires.

quote.email.label: Email
quote.email.tooltip: Send it to the customer with its PDF and a secure link where they accept or decline it.

quote.accept.label: Record accepted
quote.accept.tooltip: The customer accepted it, by email or phone: record who and when, then invoice it.

quote.decline.label: Record declined
quote.decline.tooltip: The customer said no: record when, and why if they said.

quote.cancel.label: Cancel
quote.cancel.tooltip: Withdraw it, with a reason: it stays in the records, marked cancelled, and leaves the pipeline.

quote.invoice.label: Make the invoice
quote.invoice.tooltip: Make a draft invoice of everything not invoiced yet, to check and issue.

sales.pipeline.label: Pipeline
sales.pipeline.tooltip: What the open quotes and sales orders come to in the base currency: those sent or accepted and still valid.

invoice.record-payment.label: Record a payment
invoice.record-payment.tooltip: Record money the customer has already paid into the bank: it posts at once, and what they owe goes down.

invoice.settle-in-full.label: Settle the invoice in full
invoice.settle-in-full.tooltip: Clear what is left as a settlement difference, within the organisation's settlement tolerance (S$1.00 by default); a larger shortfall stays open, or is written off.

sales.recurring-invoices.label: Recurring invoices
sales.recurring-invoices.tooltip: Invoices that repeat, weekly to yearly: each one's schedule, its next invoice, what the scheduler does with it and its status.

sales.recurring-invoice.label: Recurring invoice
sales.recurring-invoice.tooltip: One recurring invoice: its schedule, customer and lines, and whether the scheduler makes drafts or issues and sends.

recurring-invoice.new.label: New recurring invoice
recurring-invoice.new.tooltip: Bill a customer the same lines on a schedule, such as a monthly subscription.

recurring-invoice.save.label: Save
recurring-invoice.save.tooltip: Save it: a change of lines is a new version, and invoices already made keep theirs.

recurring-invoice.check.label: Check
recurring-invoice.check.tooltip: See its next invoice's date and anything that would stop its invoices being issued, without saving.

recurring-invoice.pause.label: Pause
recurring-invoice.pause.tooltip: Make no invoices until it is resumed.

recurring-invoice.resume.label: Resume
recurring-invoice.resume.tooltip: Make its invoices again from the next date; the dates it missed are skipped.

recurring-invoice.mode.label: What the scheduler does
recurring-invoice.mode.tooltip: Make a draft of each invoice for a person to issue, or issue and send each one itself once another person approves the content; a change of content needs the approval again.

recurring-invoice.ask-approval.label: Ask for approval
recurring-invoice.ask-approval.tooltip: Another person approves this content; until then, and after any change, the scheduler makes drafts.

sales.statements-reminders.label: Statements and reminders
sales.statements-reminders.tooltip: Chase what customers owe: the reminders due, a customer's statement of account, and the reminder schedules.

sales.reminders.label: Reminders due
sales.reminders.tooltip: The reminders due today, each waiting to be sent or skipped while payments are recorded by hand.

reminder.send.label: Send
reminder.send.tooltip: Email the reminder now, with the invoice's PDF and a secure link.

reminder.skip.label: Skip
reminder.skip.tooltip: Send nothing this time; the next reminder in the schedule comes when it is due.

sales.statements.label: Statement of account
sales.statements.tooltip: A customer's statement for a period: the balance brought forward, each document, and the balance due with its ageing.

statement.show.label: Show it
statement.show.tooltip: Work the statement out for the customer and period, without keeping anything.

statement.make.label: Make and email
statement.make.tooltip: Keep the statement as it is, numbered, and email it to the customer with its PDF.

statement.make-only.label: Make it
statement.make-only.tooltip: Keep the statement as it is, numbered, for an AR specialist or an Accountant to email.

sales.reminder-schedules.label: Reminder schedules
sales.reminder-schedules.tooltip: When customers' open invoices are due a reminder: the standard schedule, and each customer group's.

contact.customer-group.label: Customer group
contact.customer-group.tooltip: The reminder schedule this customer follows; none for the standard one: 3 days before the due date, on it, and 7 and 30 days after.

public.document.label: Your document
public.document.tooltip: A quote or invoice sent to you, opened through its secure link: no sign-in needed.

public.download.label: Download the PDF
public.download.tooltip: Save the document as the sender issued it, to keep for your records.

claims.my-claims.label: My claims
claims.my-claims.tooltip: Costs you paid for the company: your claims by stage, what the company still owes you, your company-card lines and your cash advances.

claims.personal.label: My claims
claims.personal.tooltip: Your own claims, card lines and cash advances: all that Fyniq shows when claims are all you do in it.

claim.new.label: New claim
claim.new.tooltip: Claim back what you paid for the company: add the receipt, what it was for and the amount on it.

claims.claim.label: Claim
claims.claim.tooltip: One of your claims: its receipts, what the expense policy says about it, and where it stands.

claims.owed.label: What the company owes you
claims.owed.tooltip: Your approved claims not yet paid back, in the base currency. Claims waiting for approval are not in it yet.

claim.save.label: Save draft
claim.save.tooltip: Keep the claim as a draft: nothing is sent for approval, and you can change it.

claim.submit.label: Submit
claim.submit.tooltip: Send the claim for approval, after you confirm it's you. Another person approves it; finance too when a line is above its limit or late.

claim.withdraw.label: Withdraw
claim.withdraw.tooltip: Take the claim back from approval: it becomes a draft again to change and submit.

claim.attach-evidence.label: Attach
claim.attach-evidence.tooltip: Attach a receipt: a photo, a screenshot or a PDF. Fyniq scans it and strips image metadata such as location; then pick it on its line.

card-line.complete.label: Complete
card-line.complete.tooltip: Say what a payment with your company card was for: the category of its receipt, or personal spend that you refund.

card-line.attach-evidence.label: Attach
card-line.attach-evidence.tooltip: Attach the receipt for a payment with your company card. It is kept, and never deleted, for as long as the records are.

claim.new-mileage.label: Mileage trip
claim.new-mileage.tooltip: Claim a business trip in your own car or motorcycle: the company pays the distance at its rate per km.

claims.trips.label: Trips
claims.trips.tooltip: The trips in your own vehicle on a draft claim: where from and to, the vehicle and the distance driven.

claims.mileage-log.label: Mileage
claims.mileage-log.tooltip: Your trips in a month, on drafts and claims alike, with the distance claimed and what each comes to.

claims.export.label: Export history
claims.export.tooltip: Download your claims as a CSV file: each one's number, date, title, stage and amount.

claims.review.label: Expense claims
claims.review.tooltip: Members' claims: those waiting for your approval, with what the expense policy says about each, and everyone's.

claims.review-claim.label: Expense claim
claims.review-claim.tooltip: A member's claim: its receipts, what the expense policy says about it, and approving or returning it.

settings.expense-policy.label: Expense policy
settings.expense-policy.tooltip: What members claim for: the categories, the account each costs, its limit a line and when a receipt or who attended is needed.

expense-policy.add.label: Add a category
expense-policy.add.tooltip: Add a category members claim for, with the account it costs and its limits.

expense-policy.load-starter.label: Load the starter categories
expense-policy.load-starter.tooltip: Start from Fyniq's categories, each on the standard chart's account: travel, meals, mileage and the rest. Check each one after.
